content.short: Altme Wallet is a non-custodial multichain wallet for managing your digital identity and assets.
content.description: Altme Wallet is a non-custodial, multichain identity wallet that gives users full autonomy over their digital identity (DID) and assets. It supports Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Fantom, Arbitrum, and OP Mainnet, enabling seamless management of coins and NFTs across networks while prioritizing privacy and data security for personal information. By keeping control of keys and credentials in the user's hands, Altme helps navigate the web3 landscape with confidence, offering a clear interface to monitor holdings, switch networks, and engage with decentralized services without compromising privacy.
